title: Be With Allah and Ask His Forgiveness
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun
Rasoolullah `alayhi salaatullah. As-salaamu `alaykum! As-salaamu `alaa jamee`i 'l-anbiyaa wa 'l-mursaleen
wa man tabi`ahum bi-ihsaan ila yawmi 'd-deen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma salaamu `alayk yaa Saahib az-Zamaan. Thumma as-salaam `alakyum yaa Aqtaab, ya Awtaad, yaa
Akhyaar, Budalaa, Nujabaa, Nuqabaa,, ya Awtaad, khassatan. As-salaamu `alayki yaa Sayyidee, wa Mawlay.
Huuuw. That Rabbaani, and he is Rabbaani wa Rabbaani, SubhaanAllah!
If there is no teacher, no one can learn anything, and the teacher of all of Mankind on this planet is that one
who Allah Almighty is saying to him, "O My beloved one! O My most honored one! O My most glorified one!
O My most majestic one! I granted Dominion Oceans and all Creation under your feet!" Allahu Akbar wa
lillaahi 'l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem and run away
from Shaytan, and take this sword heavenly sword which is a heavenly grant to believers, and say, Bismillahi
'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O our Attenders! welcome to you! There is no welcoming for those who are coming, here or Hereafter. You
must try to be welcomed ones, not to be like Shaytan and its followers, keeping out. No, you must try to be

among the welcomed ones! Whoever joins, who accepts ni`matullah, will be welcomed on Earth and in the
Hereafter; they will reach reality and be welcome! If a person is asking to be welcome, they must try to run to
such an association that makes people here or in any association, welcomed by angels! If they are losing (this
opportunity), no welcoming for them.
O our Attenders! Are you losing your chance to be invited to a heavenly feast of the Lord of Heavens? Come
and try to be true ones. That is our mission, as it was the main mission for prophets, to call people to be from
true ones. That is the honor of Mankind, to be called "true one." If you are not reaching that level to that
honor, you are losing and your whole life is going to be for nothing. This chance is to be a true one, and you
will be happy here and Hereafter! Follow the friends of Allah, Jalla Jalaaluh. It is an endless honor granted to
servants, as Allah Almighty is saying, "O People! Try to be with Me." Yes, a heavenly declaration for all
Mankind is: kun ma` Allah, "Be with Allah, Be with your Lord." Don't leave Him as He never leaves you! Kun
ma`Allah. Ask Salafi `ulamas, how can we be with Allah Almighty? Ask them and accept what they are
saying, Kun ma`Allah. It is Arabic, for understanding. And for takmilah, completion, there is another word
after Kun ma` Allah, it is, wa tooboo `ilayh. “If you are going to be with Allah Almighty, don't worry about
here or Hereafter.” No one harms you, no. Everything that harms Mankind is because they are forgetting
Almighty Allah, and everything is harming them. Therefore, kun ma` Allah.
And ask to Salafi people, who are you with? It is not easy to be with Allah Almighty. Yes, it is the highest level.
But the way that is carrying people to be with Allah Almighty, kun ma` Allah. We are such weak ones, never
understanding. Our understanding is so simple. What does it mean if you are saying, Kun ma`Allah? Where
is Allah? Laa makaanin wa laa zamaan. There is no time and no space for Allah Almighty. There is only His
existence, nothing else. Endless majesty for Him, endless honor for Him, endless glory for Him, and endless
praising for Him. Only Him! Illa-Llah. Illa-Llah. Illa-Llah.
But it is an order, kun ma`Allah. It is an order that we must be with our Lord, Allah Almighty. How can it be?
That means, first of all, who is that one who is with his Lord? He is that one whose holy name is written in
front of the Lord of Heaven's glorious Name. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Muhammad, Rasoolullah (s).
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Who is representing? Me or you? No. Glorious representing of the Day of (...), before
that also, Eternity, beginning from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. Who can be by himself in the distance and there
is no distance there? It is a grant from Allah Almighty to one, only according to his position, because no one

can be like Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! No one can be like him, in his position. There is no other Muhammad
(s), there is only one, from that One, only one. The Creator may bring endlessly Muhammad (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits)
Therefore, O people, kun ma`Allah. Try to be with Allah. And it is so difficult for us, but it is a heavenly grant
to Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s) that he is representing. He is One, Allah Almighty, and He has representatives in
all Creation, but those representatives are coming and going to be with one mutlaq, the absolute existence of
Muhammad, the Seal of Prophets (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
O People! Marhaban, marhaban! Try to be from those who are living this short life and coming back to their
real source, that it will be a divine grant for them that they will say, "O our representatives, we are taking
everything from you and we are going to be your representatives." And to be representative of Allah
Almighty, not any number can reach. And Creation is running Eternally and that Creation is never-ending.
No one is able to know how many of them, no.
O People! We are in a life that is half enlightened, and the second part is not. And people who are in darkness
and are asking to reach real enlightening lights, and who are saving themselves from the darkness of their
egos, the darkness of Shaytan's territories, will reach heavenly lights that they are looking, changing. And
they are changing, their physical being changing. What is going to happen with that changing? Allah
Almighty is dressing them in some heavenly dress that you will be able to see those lights...coming to its Lord,
saying (...buffering...) "Stand here and give your lights to My servants on that Earth." Why are you not trying
to be light-giving ones? All prophets are bringing lights to Mankind. All prophets are asking to take away
darkness, zulma from people and changing this whole Creation into lights. Now we are in the darkness of our
physical beings. When those heavenly lights are reaching you, they are taking away every darkness from your
being, changing your physical being and taking you to endless oceans that only you can find, Endless Oceans!
And you can look to Creation that Allah Almighty created, endless pleasure, endless glory, endless happiness,
endless satisfaction, endless, endless, endless, countless grants of the Lord of Heaven are going to appear in
your mirror, the real mirror that is in your heart. Therefore, Allah Almighty is saying, "I am in the heart of My
servants." Qalba 'l-mu`min `Arshullah. Anything wrong, Salafi `ulamas? It can't be wrong; Allah Almighty is
with us so no one can say this is wrong. If He is not with us, no one can be in existence! He created Man and

is endlessly making for him an enlightened spot, that may contain within it all Creation.
O People! Try to learn. We must learn something about our Lord and His most beloved servant, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) On Earth, Man is like stars in the skies. For every baby
born, a star appears in a heavenly area. No one knows that star, they only know simple signs are appearing in
us, but our real reality is in that star. That holy night of the birth of the Seal of Prophets, tasdeeqan hadha 'lamr confirmed what is written in the books of the holy life of Prophet (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
kutub al-siyaar. That night one Jewish person was shouting and running in the streets of Madinat alMunawarra, ala sakinatal (...) shouting, "O People, the star of Ahmad just appeared!" meaning Sayyidina
Rasoolullah was just born. That means every person appearing in his life, he or she has a star in heavens and
his physical being appears on this planet. When that star disappears, his physical being is just falling down.
For every person there is a star, and who is granted this secret knowledge can know it; not everyone can
know.
That star of Prophet (s) is mentioned in holy books. He was saying, “Tonight, the star of the Seal of Prophets
just appeared! O People! What we were expecting, now he is ready for us, so look after him!”
For everyone there is a star, and that star is containing the reality for you. And your real identity is there,
your life story from beginning up to the end is contained there, for Paradise people and others, just written
there. And those ahlu 'l-fen, not those scientists, they are such people that are granted such secret knowledge.
That one from Ahlu 'l-Kitaab, People of the Book, that person. And he was always looking from where the
Seal of Prophet's star was going to appear. And he was shouting, "O People! the Seal of Prophet's star just
appeared!"
Beware of Shaytan and do not follow him. Who is not following him is taken to Paradise. Who is refusing,
following Shaytan, will be taken to hells. Astaghfirullah. May Allah forgive us. Don't say, "From where
coming? From where going?" It is a grant to some ones from the nation of the Seal of Prophets (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)
O People! This is our honor. We must be thankful! Give time for respecting him daily, give much more
salawaat, greetings to him. Say, as Allah Almighty is ordering you: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)

inna-Llaha wa malaa`ikatahu yusalloona `ala 'n-nabi, yaa ayyuha 'Lladheena aamanoo salloo `alayhi was
sallimoo tasleemah. Verily, God and His angels bless the Prophet. Hence, O you who have attained to faith,
bless him and give yourselves up (to his guidance) in utter self-surrender! (33:56)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) It is a holy command, and people are giving an argument. If a mu`azzin is saying, "Assalaatu was salaamu `alayka, yaa Rasoolullah," no-mind and jahil, ignorant people are fighting about it.
Order signs pointing, that every time you must say that ta`zheem, give that glorification on the Seal of
Prophets, and you must say, Allahuma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alayh!
Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana fee sabeelillaahi, yaa
Rabbana!
Fatihah.
(38 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh Nazim speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
